scripts.preview: bun run build && wrangler pages dev
scripts.check: svelte-kit sync && bun run compile:i18n && svelte-check --tsconfig ./tsconfig.json
scripts.check:watch: svelte-kit sync && bun run compile:i18n && svelte-check --tsconfig ./tsconfig.json --watch
scripts.test: bun run compile:i18n && bun run test:unit -- --run
scripts.deploy: bun run build && wrangler pages deploy
scripts.deploy:preview: APP_ENV=preview bun run build && wrangler pages deploy .svelte-kit/cloudflare --project-name=oil-web --branch=preview --commit-dirty=true
scripts.deploy:prod: APP_ENV=production bun run build && wrangler pages deploy .svelte-kit/cloudflare --project-name=oil-web --branch=main --commit-dirty=true
